12 recommended mole removal clinics in Osaka! Compare prices and selection methods

"I want to have a mole removed in Osaka, but I don't know which clinic to choose."

“I want to know how much the price changes depending on the treatment method.”

Many people may have the same problems as mentioned above.

There are many clinics that offer mole removal in Osaka city.Treatment method, fees, location, doctor's professional qualificationsThe areas of focus vary greatly from clinic to clinic.

For flat, small molesCO2 laserFor raised moles, electric scalpel or incision is the basic guideline.Treatment methods that do not suit your mole typeSelecting will affect the finish.

In this article, we will introduce recommended mole removal clinics in Osaka.12 selectionsWe will compare and introduce the following from the viewpoints of price, treatment method, area, and aftercare system.

In addition, we will also explain the market price by size, insurance application conditions, downtime progress, and risks of commercially available goods.

Comparison based on three points: price, treatment method, and accessThis will make it easier for you to choose the clinic that is right for you.

What you can learn from this article
  • Characteristics and how to choose four types of mole removal treatment methods (CO2 laser, electric scalpel, incision method, pico laser)
  • Five points to check when choosing a clinic in Osaka (fees, doctor qualifications, location, aftercare, tissue testing)
  • Compare 12 recommended mole removal clinics in Osaka by price, treatment method, and area
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

Production flow

Types and characteristics of treatments you should know before considering mole removal in Osaka

There are many different treatment methods for mole removal.4 typesThe mole is divided intoShape, size, depth of pigmentThe appropriate method varies depending on the situation.

If you choose a treatment method that does not suit your mole, the risk of leaving it behind or leaving a scar increases.After understanding the characteristics of each treatmentThe first step is to attend counseling.

4 types of treatment methods and applicable mole types
  • CO2 laser: Ideal for flat and small moles, short downtime
  • Q-switched picolaser: If the pigment is deep, it is gradually thinned.
  • Electric scalpel: a fast-acting method to flatten raised moles in one session
  • Incision method: Surgical procedure to remove large and deep moles along with their roots

The types of moles that each correspond to are clearly divided: CO2 laser for flat and small moles, electric scalpel for moles with raised moles, incision method for large and deep moles, and Q-switch pico laser for deep pigmented moles.

Since each clinic has different equipment and treatment methods available, please first understand the type of mole you have and then proceed in the order of finding a clinic that supports that treatment.

CO2 laser is suitable for removing flat moles and small moles.

CO2 laseris the most commonly used procedure for removing small, flat moles that are located close to the skin surface.

By irradiating with a carbon dioxide laser, the tissue containing the mole's pigment cells is evaporated and removed.

Since no scalpel is used, there is almost no bleeding, and the treatment time isApproximately a few minutes per locationComplete with.

diameter2-3mm or lessIn most cases, flat moles can be removed in one treatment, and downtime tends to be relatively short.

Basic information of CO2 laser
  • Suitable for: flat, lightly pigmented moles with a diameter of 2-3 mm or less
  • Treatment time: About a few minutes per location
  • Downtime: The scab will fall off naturally in 1 to 2 weeks, and the redness will subside in 3 to 6 months.
  • Market price in Osaka: around 5,000 to 20,000 yen per location
  • Caution: There is a risk that moles larger than 5 mm or with deep pigment may be left behind.

After the treatment, a scab will form,It will peel off naturally in about 1 to 2 weeks., the redness will subside over 3 to 6 months.

If a CO2 laser is used on a mole with a diameter of 5 mm or more or a mole with deep pigment, there is a risk that it will leave something behind and cause recurrence. Check with your doctor to see if it is suitable for you.

Prices vary depending on the size of the mole, and at clinics in Osaka city,Approximately 5,000 to 20,000 yen per locationis the market price.

Q-switched pico laser is a treatment that gradually thins the pigment if it is deep.

Q-switched laser and pico laser are treatments that irradiate the pigment deposited deep into the skin with pulsed light, destroying the pigment finely and expelling it from the body.

Rather than evaporating the entire tissue like a CO2 laser,selectively decomposes only pigmentsTherefore, it is characterized by relatively little damage to the skin.

Rather than completely removing it in one treatment,Divide it into multiple doses and thin it step by step.method is often used.

The treatment interval is usuallyAbout 1 to 3 monthsThe number of times required will vary depending on the density and depth of the mole's pigment.

Summary of features of Q-switch picolaser
  • Suitable for: Moles with dark pigments and pigments that have deposited deep into the skin.
  • Mechanism: Selectively decomposes only pigments and suppresses damage to surrounding tissues
  • Number of treatments: Gradually thinned multiple times (1 to 3 months apart)
  • Pico laser has a shorter pulse width than Q-switch, further reducing damage.
  • Estimated price: 5,000 to 30,000 yen per session (total confirmation required)

This treatment may not be suitable for moles with raised bumps or moles with deeply rooted tissues. Don't judge yourself; check with your doctor through counseling.

pico laserBecause it irradiates with a shorter pulse width than the Q-switched laser, it is said to further reduce damage to surrounding tissue, and an increasing number of clinics are introducing it in recent years.

The fee isApproximately 5,000 to 30,000 yen per sessionSo, make sure to check the total amount assuming you will be visiting multiple times.

Electric scalpel is a fast-acting method to remove raised moles.

electric scalpelis a treatment that uses high-frequency current to scrape away the raised part of a mole, and is a highly effective method for treating raised moles.

Rather than making an incision with a scalpel, the tissue is cauterized and evaporated using electrical heat energy, allowing the procedure to proceed while minimizing bleeding.

A raised moleCan be flattened in one treatmentTherefore, its strength is that it can be completed quickly compared to laser treatments that require multiple hospital visits.

Types of moles suitable for electric scalpel
  • A mole that rises from the skin and becomes three-dimensional
  • If you want a procedure that does not require sutures and has a relatively quick recovery
  • If you want to flatten your skin in one treatment (those who have difficulty visiting the hospital multiple times)
  • Estimated price: 5,000 to 15,000 yen per location

After the treatment, a scab will form like with CO2 laser,Around 2 weeksIt will peel off.

With electric scalpels, it is technically difficult to adjust the depth of scraping, and if you scrape too much, it will leave a dent, and if you leave something uncut, there is a risk of recurrence. Choose a clinic with experienced doctors.

The fee isApproximately 5,000 to 15,000 yen per locationAs a guideline, there are many clinics that have a price range close to that of a CO2 laser.

When undergoing treatment, please check the doctor's treatment history and case photos in advance.

The incision method is a surgical procedure that removes large and deep moles along with their roots.

incision methodis a surgical procedure in which an incision is made around the mole with a scalpel and the tissue containing pigment cells is removed along with the root.

diameter5mm or moreThis method is selected for large moles or moles where the pigment has reached deep layers of the skin, and is suitable for cases where other treatment methods tend to leave something behind.

The extracted tissueCan be submitted for pathological examinationTherefore, a major advantage over other treatment methods is that the presence or absence of malignant tumors can be confirmed at the tissue level.

A mole that changes in color, shape, or size, or that bleeds or itch may be a malignant tumor. Please do not undergo laser treatment on your own, but first undergo a diagnosis at a clinic that supports pathological examinations.

Stitches are required after the procedure,1-2 weeks laterThe sutures will be removed.

Scars will remain as suture lines, but if the surgery is performed by a doctor with specialist qualifications in plastic surgery, suturing techniques will be used to minimize scars *Confirmation required.

Prices tend to be higher than other treatment methods, and in Osaka city,Approximately 20,000 to 80,000 yen per locationis the market price.

If you wish to undergo the incision method, choose a clinic that has a doctor with specialized qualifications in plastic surgery or dermatology.*Confirmation required.

How to choose the best treatment method for each type of mole

Mole'sshape and sizeis one of the important criteria for deciding the choice of treatment method.

During counseling, the doctor will make a diagnosis and suggest a treatment method, but it is helpful to understand the conditions for each treatment method in advance.Judge the validity of the proposal yourselfIt becomes easier.

How to choose the best treatment method for each type of mole
  • Flat and small moles (2-3mm): CO2 laser is less likely to leave a scar
  • A raised mole: Electric scalpel or incision method is suitable
  • Large moles larger than 5mm: Must be removed by incision along with the root

A flat mole and a raised mole are treated in completely different ways on the skin.

There are differences in post-surgery recovery time and results between approaches that remove superficial pigment and approaches that remove the entire tissue, so be sure to check the condition of your mole in a mirror before visiting the clinic.

CO2 laser does not leave scars on flat and small moles.

flat and diameter2〜3mmFor small moles,CO2 laseris one of the suitable treatment methods.

A CO2 laser, also known as a carbon dioxide laser, works by reacting to tissues that contain moisture and ablating the surface of the skin in a thin layer.

There is almost no bleeding as there is no incision made with a scalpel.Minimizes damage to surrounding normal skinpoint is a big advantage.

Mole conditions for which CO2 laser is suitable
  • A flat mole about 2 to 3 mm in diameter
  • A mole where the pigment remains in the shallow layers of the skin.
  • If you want to minimize bleeding without using a scalpel
  • If you want to shorten the treatment time (about a few minutes per location)

Treatment time per locationAbout a few minutesAfter the treatment, a small scab will be formed.1-2 weeksIt will fall off naturally.

However, if the pigment reaches deep layers of the skin, it may not be removed with one irradiation, and there are cases where multiple treatments are required.

CO2 laser may require re-treatment depending on the depth of the pigment. Please be sure to confirm ``how many treatments are expected'' during your consultation.

For moles that are flat and lightly pigmented, CO2 laser is used by many clinics as a treatment method that leaves less noticeable scars and results in a highly satisfactory result.

Electrocautery or incision methods are suitable for moles with raised spots.

For moles that rise from the skin and become three-dimensional,electric scalpelorincision methodis suitable.

Electrocautery is a procedure that uses high-frequency current to vaporize and cut tissue, removing the raised area by scraping it down to the same level as the skin surface.

Like the CO2 laser, it is a procedure that does not use a scalpel, so it is characterized by the fact that it does not require sutures and recovery after the procedure is relatively quick.

On the other hand, in the case of a mole with a large bulge and deep roots, electric scalpel alone may leave something behind.Combination with incision method or switching to incision method alonewill be determined by the doctor.

Guidelines for using electric scalpel and incision method
  • electric scalpel: Mole with a raised but shallow root/no sutures required, quick recovery
  • incision method: Moles with large swellings and deep roots/low risk of recurrence
  • Your doctor will determine which one is appropriate based on the depth and diameter of the mole root.
  • It is important to see a doctor who is certified in plastic surgery or dermatology.

The incision method involves removing tissue with a scalpel and suturing it, which allows for the reliable removal of deep-rooted moles.Tends to lower risk of recurrenceThe point is an advantage.

If you self-diagnose a raised mole and treat it with CO2 laser only, there is a risk of recurrence or uneven finish due to leftovers. Please choose the treatment method based on your doctor's diagnosis.

The decision as to whether electric scalpel or incision is more appropriate depends on the depth and diameter of the root of the mole, so please consult a doctor with specialized qualifications in plastic surgery or dermatology.*Confirmation required.

Large moles larger than 5mm need to be removed with the root incised.

diameter5mm or moreFor moles and large moles with pigment that extends deep into the skin,incision methodwill be your first choice.

The incision method involves making a spindle-shaped (elliptical) incision around the mole, removing the mole tissue along with its root, and closing the wound with sutures.

The recurrence rate is low because the tissue can be completely removed.In many cases, the removed tissue can be submitted for pathological examination.The point is also an important feature of the incision method.

Characteristics of moles for which incision method should be selected
  • Large mole with a diameter of 5 mm or more
  • A mole where the pigment reaches deep into the skin
  • Moles that tend to be left behind with other treatment methods
  • A mole for which the presence or absence of a malignant tumor should be confirmed by pathological examination

If you notice a change in the color, shape, or size of a mole, it is best to first get it diagnosed at a clinic that can perform tissue tests to rule out the possibility of melanoma.

After the incision, the wound is closed with sutures, so after surgery1-2 weeksThe stitches will need to be removed.

Redness and linear scars will remain immediately after the treatment, but3-6 monthsThe general process is that it gradually becomes less noticeable over time.

The larger the mole, the wider the incision area and the longer the finished scar tends to be, so we recommend choosing a clinic with a specialist in plastic surgery with an emphasis on suturing techniques *Confirmation required.

5 points to check when choosing a mole removal clinic in Osaka

In order to avoid making mistakes when choosing a clinic, here are the criteria you should check beforehand:fiveThere is.

Price transparency・By narrowing down the candidates based on these five points: the doctor's professional qualifications, location, aftercare system, and ability to respond to tissue tests, it will be easier to prevent problems after the procedure.

5 points to check when choosing a clinic
  • Transparency of fee structure: Check whether there are counseling fees, re-examination fees, and aftercare fees.
  • Specialist qualifications and case history of attending physician: Whether he or she is a specialist in dermatology or plastic surgery
  • Easy-to-reach areas: narrow down candidates from Umeda, Shinsaibashi, Namba, and Tennoji
  • Possibility of treatment on the same day and aftercare system: Check in advance the content of postoperative support
  • Ability to respond to tissue tests: Can pathological tests be performed if malignant tumor is suspected?

There are many clinics in Osaka city, mainly in Umeda, Shinsaibashi, and Namba, and even the same mole removalTotal fees and doctor's professional qualificationsThe areas of focus vary greatly from clinic to clinic.

Rather than checking for the first time on the day of your consultation, checking each point based on the official website and word-of-mouth information before making a reservation will help you make a choice you won't regret.

Make sure the fee structure is clear and check in advance whether there are counseling fees or re-examination fees.

The total cost of mole removal is not necessarily determined solely by the treatment fee.

At clinics where counseling fees, anesthesia fees, re-examination fees, and aftercare fees are charged separately, even if the treatment fee seems cheap,The final payment amount will be higherThere's a case.

Even if the official website says ``1 piece starts from 〇〇 Yen, the initial consultation fee, medicine fee, and tape fee may be calculated separately, so be sure to check the total amount at the time of counseling.

Another point to check is the price classification for each size.

in many clinicsLess than 2mm, 2-4mm, 4mm or morePrices vary depending on the size category, and if the size is increased due to same-day diagnosis, it may exceed your budget.

Regarding re-examination fees, there will be a difference in the final cost depending on clinics that include post-surgery follow-up for free and clinics that charge a fee for each visit.

When comparing multiple clinics, consider the treatment fee, initial consultation fee, re-examination fee, and aftercare fee.Compare 4 items side by side under the same conditionsIt is important to do so.

Check the doctor's specialty qualifications and case history in dermatology and plastic surgery

The finish of mole removal depends on the doctor in charge.professional qualificationsand greatly depends on experience.

Doctors with special qualifications in dermatology are strong in diagnosing skin diseases* and demonstrate high judgment accuracy in situations where confirmation is required or differentiation from malignant tumors is required.

Doctors with specialist qualifications in plastic surgery are good at minimizing scars, and are particularly good at treating large moles that require confirmation, incision, and sutures.
